mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.publisher_id, t.title, t.description, t.reward_amount, t.deposit_amount, t.deposit_status, t.category_id, c.name AS category_name, t.deadline, t.max_acceptors, t.current_acceptors, t.status, t.review_status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, r.id AS review_id, r.task_id AS review_task_id, r.reviewer_id, r.status AS review_status_val, r.reject_reason, r.reviewed_at FROM task t LEFT JOIN task_category c ON t.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM task_review WHERE task_id = #{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON t.id = r.task_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0
